epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce product runtime boot failure rate due to unresolvable Docker images from 100% to 0%
requirements: R1: The MinIO docker image tag in the deployment configuration must be updated from RELEASE.2023-09-20T22-40-07Z to a resolvable version to allow the container to start.

slices.title: Update MinIO image tag in Docker Compose configuration
slices.jtbd: When implementing the MinIO image tag fix for this epic, I want to update the docker-compose.yml configuration with a valid release tag, so that technical debt is eliminated and infrastructure standards are strictly upheld.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the Docker Compose environment is configured with the new MinIO image tag
When the runtime attempts to pull the MinIO image
Then it successfully resolves and downloads the image from Docker Hub
Given the image is downloaded
When the Docker Compose stack is started
Then the object-storage container boots successfully without reference not found errors
slices.tocConstraintRef: MinIO Docker image resolution in Docker Compose
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce MinIO image pull failure rate from 100% to 0%
